topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: These are the costs you will pay when buying or selling securities. Some examples of transaction costs include:
answer: Transaction costs are charges you may pay when buying or selling securities. Common examples include commissions, which a broker may charge for executing a trade; markups or markdowns, which are reflected in the price when a broker-dealer sells from or buys into its own inventory; and loads, which are sales charges on some mutual fund or variable annuity shares. Fees and amounts can vary among broker-dealers, so before opening an account, review which transaction costs may apply and how they are calculated.
